best_section.where: the gravel clearing about 150 m down the forestry track off Johnston Road, where vehicles are already parked

summary: A clearing deep in a pine plantation off a dirt track, already used by other vehicles, with no buildings in sight.
reasons: Vehicles already parked there in both image sets
No buildings or houses anywhere near

drivers.seclusion: Boxed in by rows of plantation trees on both sides with no dwellings visible in either the 2022 or 2025 imagery; the only sightline is along the access track.
drivers.access_and_room: A graded dirt track runs about 150 m in from Johnston Road to a clearing wide enough for several vehicles; a light 2WD van should manage it in dry conditions, though it's unsealed the whole way.
drivers.traffic: No through traffic — it's a dead-end plantation track serving the clearing, not a road.
drivers.convention: Other vehicles (a car/ute and what looks like a trailer) are parked in the clearing in both the 2022 QLD and 2025 Esri images, so a van parking there matches existing use.

flags: Gentle slope: around 3% mean grade over the approach, nothing steep at the clearing itself
Unsealed track — condition after rain can't be judged from imagery
sun_shade: Mostly open sky above the clearing itself, with tall plantation trees close in on the east and west sides cutting low morning and evening sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the track entrance from Johnston Road has a gate or chain
Ground firmness/softness of the unsealed track and clearing
Any on-site signage restricting access or camping
